Businesses are moving to Ajman, making it one of the fastest-growing business destinations in the UAE. In 2025 alone, the emirate issued more than 18,000 new licenses. You can join them too as an entrepreneur by getting your trade license in Ajman,

According to Khaleej Times, new licences issued increased by 5 percent in Ajman during the first half of 2024 compared with the same period in 2023, reaching about 3,000 new licences.

Ajman business setup 2026 is being prioritized by entrepreneurs who are launching their first ventures and established companies that are expanding their operations. The reason behind it is how simple, fast, practical, and far less complicated this option is.

Still, you might have questions, queries, concerns about factors, such as:

  • Which license type fits your activity?
  • Should you even choose an Ajman DED license, or does a free zone option work better?
  • Which documents are the authorities going to ask for?
  • Are you going to need PRO services? Will those make processes easier for you?

We hear you, and we answer all these in this guide, which covers:

  • Different license types that you can apply for
  • How mainland and free zone setups compare, and which might be the right one for you
  • Documents you will need to accompany your application
  • Steps to complete your application
  • How experienced PRO support saves you time and prevents any costly mistakes

Types of Trade Licenses Available in Ajman

There are several Ajman trade license types. These suit a specific category for business activities, as not every business needs the same type of license. 

Choosing the right license is important because it determines:

  • What you can legally do
  • How many visas can you get for your employees
  • What facilities may you need

Commercial (Trading) License

A commercial license Ajman covers trading activities. So if you are an import/export, wholesale distribution, retail shop, or a company buying and selling goods locally or internationally, this license is for you. Ajman’s Department of Economic Development issues these licenses for mainland companies.

One of the biggest advantages of this license is having the general trading license option. You can have multiple product categories under one license. This reduces administrative complexity as compared to some other emirates. For many entrepreneurs, this flexibility alone is what makes Ajman a strong contender to be the spot for launching their business.

Professional (Service) License

The professional license category is for you if you are a consultant or a service provider. IT firms, marketing agencies, accountants, legal advisors, management consultancies, and design studios all operate under this license type. 

Unlike for trading licenses, a physical storefront or warehouse is usually not required. That keeps overhead manageable for service-focused companies. Sole establishment structure is common among businesses that have a professional license. 

Industrial or Manufacturing License

You need to get an industrial license if your business involves manufacturing, assembling, or processing products.

The authorities will ask applicants to demonstrate access to a production facility before they sign off on the approval. Companies operating in free zones such as AFZ (Ajman Free Zone) are required to show that a significant portion of their manufacturing activity happens within the zone.

Ajman is often the most practical option for manufacturers who want logistics access and cost efficiency. 

E-commerce License

Online sellers have their own category now. An e-commerce license Ajman businesses use covers both B2B and B2C online operations. Sellers running stores on platforms such as Amazon UAE, Noon, or Talabat usually apply under this category.

As for the Ajman Free Zone, it has introduced a dedicated e-commerce license option that works well for digital businesses.

Another interesting option you can explore is the Ajman Media City freelance permit. It includes a license and visa allocation in one package, which makes it appealing for freelancers starting their independent digital ventures.

Pioneers Package License

Ajman also offers a unique initiative called the Pioneers Package license. The program is specifically for recent graduates and young entrepreneurs.

It removes many of the financial commitments normally associated with starting a company. New founders can test ideas and build experience without committing large amounts of capital at the start.

There are very few other emirates that offer a similar initiative. 

Ajman Mainland vs Free Zone: Which Trade License is Right for You?

You now have the license category figured out. Now the next decision is business structure:

  • Should you open a mainland company?
  • Should you register inside a free zone?

Your target market, operational needs, and growth plans are what affect this choice between these two options.

Ajman DED Mainland License

A mainland company operates under the Ajman Department of Economic Development.

Recent changes to the UAE Commercial Companies Law introduced a major benefit for foreign investors. Many business activities now allow 100% foreign ownership UAE-wide, including in Ajman. This means international founders can establish mainland businesses without needing a local partner for most activities.

As a mainland company, you can trade directly within the UAE market and work with government entities. For businesses targeting local customers, this structure often makes the most sense.

Ajman Free Zone Authority (AFZA) License

Free zones operate under separate authorities. Ajman Free Zone is one of the most established.

Companies registered here enjoy streamlined processes, flexible office options, and tax-friendly policies.

However, free zone companies usually work through local distributors when selling directly inside the UAE mainland market.

We illustrate a quick comparison of these license types in a table format to help you simplify your choice:

Factor Mainland DED Free Zone AFZA Best For
Market access Direct access to the UAE market Usually through distributors Businesses targeting UAE consumers
Ownership percentage Often 100% foreign ownership 100% foreign ownership International founders
Office requirement Physical office lease Flexi desk or office options Startups and remote teams
Visa quota Linked to office size Based on the license package Teams planning to hire
Setup speed Moderate Often faster Digital businesses
Minimum cost Varies based on activity Often entry-friendly Freelancers and startups
  • The right answer depends on how and where you plan to operate.

Ajman Trade License Cost and Required Documents in 2026

Most entrepreneurs want to know two things before they apply for their trade license:

  1. Expected cost range
  2. Required documents

How Much Will an Ajman Trade License Cost You?

The Ajman trade license cost 2026 depends on several factors:

  • your business activity
  • license category
  • visa requirements
  • office arrangements

All these elements influence the final sum:

  • As a commercial trading company, you will have to budget for activity approval, name reservation, licensing fees, and office registration.
  • As a service-based company, you may have fewer facility requirements, which can reduce the setup costs.
  • Industrial licenses include additional approvals because production facilities require inspection.
  • Free zone packages often bundle services such as workspace access and visa eligibility into one package.

Don’t overlook VAT when you are budgeting for all the expenses associated with a business setup. A 5% VAT applies to professional service fees related to company setup. This includes PRO service charges and notarisation services involved during registration.

Documents You Need for Your Trade License in Ajman

Authorities ask for a standard documentation set before approving an application. Here’s a checklist for the usually required documents;

  • A passport copy of the owner or shareholders
  • Passport-sized photographs
  • Entry stamp or residence visa copy, if applicable
  • Proposed trade name options
  • Business activity details
  • Memorandum of Association for certain company structures
  • Office lease agreement or free zone flexi desk agreement
  • Initial approval application form

Preparing these correctly from the start helps avoid delays later.

How PRO Services Simplify Your Ajman Trade License Application

Many entrepreneurs attempt to handle the entire process alone. Some succeed. Many discover halfway through that paperwork and approvals take more time than expected.

This is the point where PRO services Ajman businesses become valuable. They save you cost, resources, time, and a lot of stress. Here’s how:

Our PRO team reviews your every document against the current DED or AFZA checklist before submission. They catch mismatched names, incomplete forms, or missing approvals that usually cause rejection. That extra step of reviewing prevents unnecessary back and forth with authorities.

Our PRO professionals maintain working relationships with Ajman DED and AFZA officials. We communicate directly with departments responsible for reviewing your applications. When clarification is needed, we are quick to resolve it.

Applications are submitted and tracked through the Ajman DED e-services portal and mobile app. Clients can monitor approval status while our PRO team handles the administrative follow-up.

Visa, Ejari, and Post License Compliance Support

Getting the license is only the beginning. But we don’t stop there.

The PRO support continues with your investor visa applications, employee visa quota management, Emirates ID processing, and Ejari registration.

Many businesses also rely on our PRO services for license amendments, adding new activities, updating trade names, or modifying shareholders, all of which all require formal approval.

Renewal reminders are another benefit most people overlook when considering whether they want to handle the process solo or want assistance from a reliable PRO service provider. Since missing deadlines can lead to fines, consistent monitoring protects your business continuity.

Step-by-Step Process to Get Your Trade License in Ajman

The Ajman trade license process steps follow a clear sequence:

  • Step 1: Reserve your trade name using the Ajman DED mobile app or e-services portal.
  • Step 2: Choose your business activity and license type. Decide between mainland and free zone structures.
  • Step 3: Secure office space through an Ejari-registered lease or free zone flexi desk agreement.
  • Step 4: Submit the initial approval application along with the required documents.
  • Step 5: Prepare and notarise the Memorandum of Association if forming a multi-shareholder company.
  • Step 6: Pay the licensing fee through the official portal and receive your digital trade license.
  • Step 7: Apply for investor or employee visas through the ICP portal.
  • Step 8: Complete the medical fitness test and Emirates ID biometrics.

The first several steps can be completed remotely. Free zone approvals are even quicker if your documentation is already organized. In contrast, mainland approvals might take you slightly longer, depending on your business activity.

Frequently Asked Questions About Trade Licenses in Ajman

What is the cost of a trade license in Ajman in 2026?

Costs vary depending on the business activity, visa allocations, and office requirements. Free zone packages and mainland licenses each have different fee structures.

How long does it take to get a trade license in Ajman?

Many applications are approved within a few working days once documents are submitted correctly.

Can a foreigner own 100% of a business in Ajman?

UAE company law now allows full foreign ownership for many business activities.

What is the difference between Ajman mainland and free zone licenses?

Mainland companies can trade directly within the UAE market, whereas free zone companies usually operate internationally or through distributors.

What documents are required for a trade license in Ajman?

Authorities usually request passport copies, photographs, activity details, and office lease agreements.

Do I need a PRO service to get a trade license in Ajman?

It is not mandatory. Many businesses use PRO services to avoid delays and efficiently handle government approvals.

How do I renew my Ajman trade license?

Renewal requires submitting updated documents, paying the renewal fee, and confirming your office lease remains valid.
